title: Practice 2: «To begin doing»: за- and others

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Tom groaned when he saw the long queue at the checkout.
exercises.ru: Том ___, увидев длинную очередь на кассе.
exercises.why: **застонал** — застона́ть (perfective): to start moaning. Wiktionary: за- + стона́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (colloquial) to burst out laughing, to roar with laughter
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: забе́гать — to start running; расхохота́ться — (colloquial) to burst out laughing, to roar with laughter; загреме́ть — to begin to thunder; заинтересова́ть — to (start to) interest, to concern.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to sob/blubber, to burst out sobbing
to start muttering, to start mumbling
to start swimming, to start floating
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: зарыда́ть — to begin to sob/blubber, to burst out sobbing; забормота́ть — to start muttering, to start mumbling; потащи́ть — to start pulling; поплы́ть — to start swimming, to start floating.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to (begin to) howl, to raise a howl
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: завы́ть — to (begin to) howl, to raise a howl; зашепта́ть — to begin to whisper; зашага́ть — to begin to walk; застона́ть — to start moaning.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: влете́ть — to fly into; заскрипе́ть — to begin to creak; опу́хнуть — to swell; возненави́деть — to hate, to start hating.
